text:
Ivy (sales): Passing off MeridianBank. Closed deal for Private (VPC) + SSO. GA target 2026-05-01. Customer concerned about cost visibility and occasional latency at high concurrency.

Ken (CS): I'll own onboarding. Need SAML certs, VPC CIDR, and list of burst routes. Also curious if they require log residency.

Ivy (sales): SOW and compliance sent: https://redwood.internal/docs/meridian-sow. Network lead is ops@meridianbank.com. SAML certs will be uploaded today. They want model pinned to rwd-stable-13b.

Lina (CSM): I'll run enablement and weekly health checks. Proposed first kickoff Thu 2026-03-26.

Omar (eng-oncall): For VPC we need them to allowlist 172.20.0.0/16 and open 443. Also request sample slow payloads (>1k tokens) and any embedding-heavy endpoints.

Ken (CS): Actions:
- Ivy: upload SAML cert + network contact (due 2026-03-12)
- Omar: prepare VPC checklist + quick perf mitigations (due 2026-03-15)
- Lina: schedule kickoff + send agenda (due 2026-03-13)
- InfraBot: create internal perf ticket

InfraBot: Ticket INC-20260312-7701 created for MeridianBank perf monitoring.

Omar (eng-oncall): Quick mitigation: suggest customer set batch_hint=1 for embeddings and enable prefix KV caching. Example curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-stable-13b","input":"<payload>","meta":{"batch_hint":1}}'

Lina (CSM): They also asked for a token-cost alert and weekly latency digest. Can we provision a temporary dashboard tagged customer:meridianbank with 30-day retention?

Omar (eng-oncall): Yes, will request dashboard and 30-day logs. Will post staging load test results after deploy.

Ken (CS): Renewal note: customer likely to commit to reserved capacity if we hit p95 <120ms consistently. I'll log this in the renewal tracker.

Ivy (sales): Uploaded certs: https://files.redwood.internal/secure/meridian/saml.pem :thumbsup:

Lina (CSM): Plan for next 72h: confirm allowlist, validate staging deploy, and run kickoff. I'll post status updates here every Friday.
